verses.t: “Yo dandhakāle tarati, taraṇīye ca dandhaye; Ayoni saṁvidhānena, bālo dukkhaṁ nigacchati.
Tassatthā parihāyanti, kāḷapakkheva candimā; Āyasakyañca pappoti, mittehi ca virujjhati.
Yo dandhakāle dandheti, taraṇīye ca tāraye; Yoniso saṁvidhānena, sukhaṁ pappoti paṇḍito.
Tassatthā paripūrenti, sukkapakkheva candimā; Yaso kittiñca pappoti, mittehi na virujjhatī”ti. … Sambhūto thero ….
